scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Yuba Yogajog Yojana In Tripura
other_conditions: Must be a resident of Tripura state
Must be studying in a college located in Tripura
Must be an undergraduate student in the final year of the graduation course
Benefits can be availed only once in a lifetime
Applicant must purchase a smartphone in his/her name after the scheme announcement
benefits_summary: The scheme provides a one‑time scholarship of ₹5,000 and a grant for purchasing a smartphone to final‑year undergraduate students in Tripura.
